mentions.name: Saidia
mentions.description: This is an offline-first desktop app that generates questions for teachers, reducing the time spent manually creating them.
mentions.problem: Teachers in rural areas are underserved by AI tools and spend significant time manually creating questions.
mentions.audience: Teachers, particularly those in rural parts of the world who have a laptop but lack access to AI services.
mentions.source_excerpt: I noticed that a lot of them still manually create questions which is a time consuming process. I created an offline first desktop app for this. https://github.com/dokasto/Saidia
